NAME
       quit command - Exits tmsh.

MODULE
       All tmsh modules.

SYNTAX
       Use the following command at the tmsh prompt to close tmsh and return to the BIG-IP(r) system prompt.

	quit

       Note that to exit a tmsh module or component, you use the command exit.

SEE ALSO
       tmsh
